description: This file defines the code-behind for the SignUpPage of an online examination system, handling user registration by processing form inputs, saving user images, and inserting user data into a database.

classes.name: SignUpPage
classes.description: Code-behind class for the SignUpPage ASP.NET page, managing user registration logic and UI interactions.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Event handler called when the page loads; currently does nothing.

methods.name: loginB_Click
methods.description: Handles the login button click event by redirecting to the LoginPage.

methods.name: signUpB_Click
methods.description: Handles the sign-up button click event: validates passwords, saves uploaded image, inserts user data into the database, and redirects upon success.
